title: Graph structure has two competing sources of truth (edges vs _isChildOf/_stepPath metadata) with no central normalization seam
existing_state: Container membership is decided by node metadata (_isChildOf + _stepPath), NOT edges, for imported graphs -- but canvas-built graphs have no metadata, so every structural consumer carries a dual-origin code path: treeBuilder tries buildBranchesMeta then falls back to buildBranchesEdges (FlowCanvas/src/utils/layout/treeBuilder.ts:63-67); edgePath classifies branch edges via data.branchPath OR target _isChildOf and correlates taken-branches two different ways (edgePath.ts:58-63, 177-192); branchBands groups purely by _isChildOf (branchBands.ts:156-169); export regeneration rebuilds nesting from metadata. childMembership.ts:1-12 documents the seam and exists precisely because wiring a fresh block used to orphan it. This duplication has a documented defect history (issue #45 sibling drop/promote, the rewire-into-band bug, the _stepPath-contiguity dead-neon bug), and a live hole remains today: pasteNodes deep-copies node data verbatim (utils/clipboard.ts:44-57) and the paste site strips nothing (hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts:63-74), so a pasted child still carries _isChildOf/_stepPath pointing at the ORIGINAL container -- branchBands draws it inside the original band, treeBuilder nests it under the original container, renumberStepPaths renumbers it as a sibling of the original branch, and metadata-driven export can double-place it. Every new structural entry point (paste today; future duplicate/drag-into-band/group ops) must independently remember all metadata invariants or it ships another bug of this class.
recommendation: Introduce a single normalization seam: a normalizeStructure(nodes, edges) pass owning the invariants (membership matches wiring, _stepPath contiguous per branch, cosmetics/_forceGraphExport consistent) that every structural entry point routes through -- import (load-graph), onConnect, paste, delete paths, undo/redo restore. Short-term, fix paste inside it (strip or remap _isChildOf/_stepPath/_membershipFromConnect via the paste idMap). Longer-term, collapse the dual origin: derive and write membership metadata for canvas-authored nodes at connect time for ALL gestures (childMembership already covers three), so treeBuilder/edgePath/branchBands can drop their edge-walking fallbacks and metadata becomes the only structural source of truth.
user_benefit: Stops the recurring class of wrong-band / wrong-export / dead-highlight bugs that has already produced several shipped defects, and makes new graph operations (duplicate, group, drag-into-container) safe to build.

evidence.note: membership decided by metadata, not edges; module exists to patch one entry point (connect)
dual builders: metadata first, edge-walk fallback
dual-origin branch identity and taken-branch correlation
paste copies stale _isChildOf/_stepPath/_membershipFromConnect verbatim; no entry point normalizes it
